title: Rehearsal and arrivals
closedNotice: This occasion is closed: you can read everything, but nothing can be changed.

hub.heroNote: Households arrived: {arrived} of {expected} · not yet here: {left}
hub.memberIntro: Your own checklist and the sustainability goals of the occasion.
hub.rehearsalBody: Step through the day and see what collides, without changing anything.
hub.checklistBody: The ticks of your own tasks. Works without internet too.
hub.offlineBody: What waits on this device and what needs your decision.
hub.sustainabilityNone: Optional: measured goals, if you want to track them.

flow.title: Arrival flow
flow.projectionLabel: When most guests will be in:
flow.unknown: unknown — not enough arrivals yet to estimate
flow.reached: Most guests are in: {percent}% of those expected are here.
flow.estimate: At the pace of the last half hour (about {perHour} people an hour), most guests will be in around {time}. An estimate, not a promise.
flow.foot: Numbers only: how many people arrived in each interval. Bars start at zero.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.heroNote: Households arrived: {arrived} of {expected} · not yet here: {left}
checkin.searchHint: Search a name or scan the code on the invitation. One tap records the arrival.
checkin.scanning: Hold the code on the invitation in front of the camera.
checkin.scanUnsupported: This device cannot read codes with its camera. Type the code beside this or search the household by name.
checkin.cameraDenied: We have no access to the camera. Allow it in the browser or type the code by hand.
checkin.fbUnknownCode: Unknown code for this occasion. Search the household by name.
checkin.fbUnknownOffline: The code is not in the list on this device and you are offline. Search the household by name.
checkin.emptyRosterBody: Add the households under Guests, then come back to check in.
checkin.noMatch: No name matches. Try another name from the household.
checkin.more: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Type more letters to narrow the list.
checkin.staleRoster: Offline: this is the list saved on this device. Arrivals are sent when the connection returns.
checkin.noRoster: Offline, with no list saved on this device. Open this screen once while connected, before the event.
checkin.correctIntro: An arrival is a fact. You can change it only with a reason, and the old value stays in the history.
checkin.correctUndo: Did not actually arrive (undo the arrival)
checkin.correctUndoHint: The household goes back to the not-yet-arrived list.
checkin.correctReasonHint: For example: I ticked another household by mistake.

checklist.title: My checklist
checklist.description: The ticks of the tasks you are accountable for. You can tick without internet; they are sent when the connection returns.
checklist.emptyBody: The checklists of your tasks and your packing lists appear here.
checklist.stale: Offline: this is the list saved on this device.
checklist.none: Offline, with no list saved on this device. Open this screen once while connected.

offline.title: Sync
offline.description: Without internet you can record arrivals and your own ticks only. They are sent once, when the connection returns.
offline.offlineBody: You can carry on: arrivals and your ticks are kept on this device.
offline.failed: The sync did not work. Nothing was lost; try again.
offline.empty: Nothing is waiting on this device.
offline.noConflicts: No conflicts. Everything you sent was applied or was already recorded.
offline.removedItem: An item that was removed meanwhile
offline.changedBody: From “{task}”. It changed on the server after you ticked it offline. It is now {server}; you left it {wanted}.
offline.removedBody: The item no longer exists, so your tick ({wanted}) has nowhere to go.

rehearsal.title: Rehearse the day
rehearsal.readOnly: The rehearsal only reads the plan. It changes and saves nothing.
rehearsal.noDate: The occasion has no date yet
rehearsal.noDateBody: Set the date to rehearse the day.
rehearsal.emptyTitle: Nothing with a time on this day
rehearsal.emptyBody: The rehearsal strings together the moments that have a time: event-day tasks, legs, transport, activities, deliveries.
rehearsal.emptyAction: Set times on the event day

conflicts.overlap_person: {person} would have to be in two places: “{a}” and “{b}” overlap.
conflicts.overlap_everyone: “{a}” and “{b}” overlap, and both involve everyone.
conflicts.overlap_supplier: The supplier {supplier} has two slots that overlap: “{a}” and “{b}”.
conflicts.overlap_place: Two things in the same place ({place}) at the same time: “{a}” and “{b}”.
conflicts.dependency_order: “{a}” depends on “{b}”, but “{b}” is scheduled later.
conflicts.delivery_late: The delivery “{a}” is expected by {at}, but “{b}” starts at {need}. Check whether it is needed earlier.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Goals tracked against measured quantities. What was not measured stays unknown.
sustainability.emptyBody: If you wish, choose what to track — food waste, for instance — and note the measurements as you go.
sustainability.emptyBodyMember: The organisers have set no goals for this occasion.
sustainability.addIntro: Choose what you measure and, if you like, a target. Without a target the goal only shows what was measured.
sustainability.targetHint: Leave empty if you have no target yet.

words.unknown: There is no measurement yet, so we cannot say whether the goal is met.
words.measured: There are measurements, but not enough to say the goal is met.
words.on_track: What was measured meets the target.
words.behind: What was measured misses the target.

sustainability.partUnknown: Some of the measurements are unknown.

measureIntro.sum: Enter what was measured now. Quantities add up.
measureIntro.latest: Enter the current value. The latest measurement counts.

sustainability.unknownHint: It is recorded as unknown — not as zero.

exports.arrivalsDescription: Every household, with what was expected and who arrived.

errors.householdNotFound: The household is no longer on the guest list.
errors.itemRemoved: The checklist item was removed meanwhile.
errors.valueOrUnknown: Enter what was measured or tick “It could not be measured”.
